boards.name: Cambridge (CAIE) via British Council
boards.notes: per_subject_fee of PKR 32,920 is the confirmed official May/June 2026 fee sampled across multiple subjects (Accounting 7707, Additional Mathematics 4037, Arabic 3180, Art & Design 6090) from a British Council 'Fee Calculation Form MJ2026 Pakistan'. Independent vault research (08-pakistan-muslim-global-south.md) and a Senate committee complaint cite a wider PKR 35,000-60,000/subject range for 2025-26 sessions and press coverage of a 'Rs60,000 fee' — treat 32,920 as the confirmed floor for a typical (non-science-practical) subject; science subjects with practicals run higher per multiple secondary sources (thinkerzz.com cites PKR 30,000-35,000 general range, sciences higher). AS/A Level per-subject fee could not be separately confirmed this pass (cambrilearn.com cites a vague ~$90-140 USD equivalent, not a PKR figure) — left null rather than guessed. Late-entry surcharge of 25-50% per subject is a secondary-source range (thinkerzz.com), not an official schedule; midpoint 37.5% given as amount_pct, no confirmed PKR amount. A separate PKR 1,500/subject withdrawal-before-deadline admin fee is also documented (thinkerzz.com, learnersacademy.com.pk) but is not the same as late-entry surcharge so is not placed in that field. Registration/admin charge of PKR 10,000-15,000 is from vault research citing stateofchildren.com and a Reddit private-candidate thread, not an official British Council fee page; use 12,500 (range midpoint) with low confidence. Exact exam-centre city list by board is not compiled anywhere in the source research (open question in 02-A-exam-cost-records.md) — cities listed are the commonly-cited major British Council exam centres, not a verified exhaustive list. Late-entry surcharge estimated at ~37.5% of the base per-subject fee (secondary-source range 25-50%, no confirmed PKR amount). SECOND PASS 2026-09-09: britishcouncil.pk and internationalschools.britishcouncil.org were checked again -- the official private-candidate registration pages confirm fees are 'within the SRS' (School Registration System, login-gated) and NOT published publicly; britishcouncil.pk itself returns an Akamai 'Access Denied' to automated fetches regardless of user-agent. New secondary-source range found: thinkerzz.com/a-level-fees-pk/ states A Level (AS+A2 combined program) exam fees run PKR 40,000-50,000/subject, with AS and A2 paid as two SEPARATE entries (not one AS+A2 fee), and states a late-registration surcharge of PKR 5,000-10,000/subject on top of the standard fee (still not an official BC figure -- amount field left null per the 'never guess' rule, this range is prose-only). Still no confirmed single official PKR figure for AS/A Level distinct from the O Level/IGCSE 32,920 already confirmed -- left null.

boards.name: AKU-EB (Aga Khan University Examination Board)
boards.notes: CONFIRMED 2026-09-09 from official AKU-EB SSC and HSSC Private Candidate Registration Form PDFs (Annual Examinations 2027, examinationboard.aku.edu, fee table on page 4 of each form). AKU-EB charges a single flat 'Candidate Enrolment and Exam Registration Fee' PER GROUP choice (e.g. Science, Humanities, Pre-Medical) that covers ALL subjects in that group -- it is NOT a per-subject fee like Cambridge's, and groups are mutually exclusive (a candidate picks one), so no single number can correctly populate this schema's per_subject_fee or fixed_fees fields without producing a wrong total in the calculator (summing all groups would double/triple-count a candidate who only pays for one). Both per_subject_fee and fixed_fees are left null/empty for that reason; the confirmed group fees are recorded here as reference only: SSC-I Humanities PKR 28,100 / Science PKR 32,500; SSC-II Humanities PKR 31,500 / Science PKR 34,800; HSSC-I Humanities PKR 41,600 / Commerce PKR 41,500 / Pre-Engineering PKR 45,000 / Science General PKR 45,100 / Pre-Medical PKR 45,800; HSSC-II Humanities PKR 39,600 / Commerce PKR 39,500 / Pre-Engineering PKR 42,100 / Science General PKR 42,500 / Pre-Medical PKR 42,800. Add-ons (also flat, not summed here): additional theory subject PKR 7,000, additional practical subject PKR 5,500, re-sit/ex-candidate exam registration fee PKR 4,500 (waived for part-II candidates re-sitting a part-I subject), Practical fee for Art & Model Drawing/Fine Arts PKR 5,500. Late penalty fee is flat per candidate (not per subject), left null in late_entry_surcharge.amount for the same mutual-exclusivity-with-group reasoning is not the issue here (it genuinely is one flat number) but is recorded in prose instead since the schema field doesn't support multiple stages: NIL up to the regular deadline (Fri Oct 30, 2026), PKR 10,000 Stage 1 (Nov 2-14, 2026), PKR 15,000 Stage 2 (Nov 15-21, 2026), PKR 20,000 Stage 3 (Nov 22-30, 2026) -- same 4 stages/amounts apply to both SSC and HSSC forms. Registration is Karachi-office-only (hard-copy submission), a real accessibility cost for non-Karachi families not captured by a PKR figure. Fee paid via HBL bank deposit or pay order to 'The Aga Khan University' (NTN 1206240-5). Next update: if this schema ever adds a per-group fee structure, populate it directly from this note instead of re-fetching the PDFs.

boards.name: BISE Lahore (Board of Intermediate & Secondary Education, Lahore)

fixed_fees.label: Candidate/enrolment fee (separate SSC enrolment challan sample)

boards.notes: BISE Lahore does not publish a single clean per-subject or total private-candidate fee schedule the way Cambridge does — figures compiled here come from a BISE Lahore official Facebook page fee announcement (Aug 2026, SSC Second Annual Examination 2026) and a separate sample SSC enrolment challan (Scribd, total PKR 2,020 for one candidate). These line items are NOT confirmed to sum to one consistent total — do not add them together and present as a fixed total without re-verifying against the current session's official notification on biselahore.com. This is far cheaper than Cambridge (low hundreds to a few thousand PKR vs tens of thousands per subject), consistent with vault research calling BISE fees 'nominal by comparison, not separately itemized in sources found.' Private-candidate registration runs through registration.biselahore.com / privatereginter.biselahore.com, which requires the candidate to have never previously enrolled at BISE Lahore. SECOND PASS 2026-09-09: confirmed a 2027-cycle private-candidate registration schedule PDF exists (Pvt_RegSch(1stA27).pdf, linked from biselahore.com/notifications) but it is an Urdu-only document using a custom/non-Unicode font -- pdftotext extracts garbled characters, not usable text, and OCR was out of scope for this pass. A separate current-session fee schedule (Admission And Fee Schedule For SSC 2nd Annual 2026.pdf, biserawalpindi.edu.pk -- note this is the RAWALPINDI board's document, not Lahore's, found while researching a neighbouring board) shows a real fee table (Rs.1500/750/750, Rs.1600/800/800, Rs.1000 rows, total Rs.3500 line) but the column/row headers are Urdu and could not be attributed to specific candidate categories (regular vs private, which group) without translation -- not used here to avoid mis-assigning a number to the wrong field. Facebook posts citing specific PKR figures (e.g. 'Rs.3900', 'Rs.1000') for BISE fee schedules could not be independently verified: fetching those post URLs returns Facebook's login-gated shell with no message text (only a title fragment), so the figures seen in search-engine snippets are unconfirmed and were NOT added. per_subject_fee remains null; fixed_fees unchanged from first pass.
